"""RoboPaint trajectory driver for copying 年 with a Panda calligraphy brush."""
import sys, math, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)


def linseg(a, b, speed=0.12, dt=DT):
    """Sample one straight tip segment at a conservative Cartesian speed."""
    a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/(speed*dt))))
    return np.linspace(a, b, n+1)[1:]


def path_rows(points, speed=0.12, dwell_s=0.0, dt=DT):
    """Sample a sequence of XYZ control points and append an optional endpoint dwell."""
    pts = [np.asarray(p, float) for p in points]
    rows = []
    for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:]):
        rows.extend(linseg(a, b, speed, dt))
    if dwell_s:
        rows.extend([pts[-1]] * max(1, int(round(dwell_s/dt))))
    return np.asarray(rows, float)


def send_path(r, points, speed=0.12, dwell_s=0.0, note="", video="mp4", cameras=None):
    rows = path_rows(points, speed=speed, dwell_s=dwell_s)
    poses = np.c_[rows, np.tile(DOWN, (len(rows), 1))]
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", poses, dt=DT, video=video, cameras=cameras, note=note)
    print(note, "rows", len(rows), "plan", res.meta.get("plan"), "stopped", res.stopped)
    return res


def xyz_now(r):
    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam"], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], float)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    r = Robot()
    status = r.status()
    print("connected", status)
    p = xyz_now(r)
    # Raise clear of the tabletop, move to the ink well, immerse below its ink surface, then lift.
    send_path(r, [p, [p[0], p[1], 0.22]], speed=0.10, note="raise_clear")
    send_path(r, [[p[0], p[1], 0.22], [-0.10, 0.15, 0.22]], speed=0.12, note="travel_ink")
    res = send_path(r, [[-0.10, 0.15, 0.22], [-0.10, 0.15, 0.015]], speed=0.06, dwell_s=0.6, note="dip_ink")

    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam", "scene_cam"], video="frames")
    from PIL import Image
    for cam, im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/after_dip_{cam}.png")
    print("post_dip", r.status(), "tip", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14])

PAPER_Z = 0.020
MM_PER_TARGET_PX = 0.22186
SHEET_FAR_X = 0.0135925
SHEET_LEFT_Y = 0.1135925


def linseg(a, b, speed=0.12, dt=DT):
    a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/(speed*dt))))
    return np.linspace(a, b, n+1)[1:]


def path_rows(points, speed=0.12, dwell_s=0.0, dt=DT):
    pts = [np.asarray(p, float) for p in points]
    rows = []
    for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:]):
        rows.extend(linseg(a, b, speed, dt))
    if dwell_s:
        rows.extend([pts[-1]] * max(1, int(round(dwell_s/dt))))
    return np.asarray(rows, float)


def send_path(r, points, speed=0.12, dwell_s=0.0, note="", video="none", cameras=None):
    rows = path_rows(points, speed=speed, dwell_s=dwell_s)
    poses = np.c_[rows, np.tile(DOWN, (len(rows), 1))]

    bad = sum(int(x.get("ik_failures", 0)) for x in res.meta.get("plan", []))
    slow = sum(bool(x.get("slowed")) for x in res.meta.get("plan", []))
    print(note, "rows", len(rows), "ik_failures", bad, "slowed", slow, "stopped", res.stopped)
    return res

    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam"], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], float)

    """Ink once and test 5, 8, and 11 mm pressure on the practice paper."""
    p = xyz_now(r)
    send_path(r, [p, [p[0], p[1], .22], [-.10, .15, .22]], speed=.10, note="raise_and_travel_ink")
    send_path(r, [[-.10, .15, .22], [-.10, .15, .015]], speed=.06, dwell_s=.6, note="dip_ink")
    send_path(r, [[-.10, .15, .015], [-.10, .15, .16]], speed=.08, note="lift_ink")
    # Practice sheet checks from the actual episode: one 8 mm line, plus 5 mm
    # and 11 mm lines. They do not count toward the scored stroke limit.
    def practice_xy(u, v, z):
        return [-.10-(v-512)*.45/1834.508, -.1856-(u-256)*.45/1834.508, z]
